title: Launch Priority Lens — Mini Canvas & KPI Tracker
body:
Purpose:
A compact, operational canvas to decide go/no-go (and partial go) for launches that materially affect inference economics or latency (hosted / dedicated / private). Use as an on-call-friendly checklist + KPI snapshot for production ops and product owners.

Scope and quick context:
- Applies to feature launches, model serving changes, or routing/policy updates that touch model selection, batching, caching, or traffic split logic.
- Designed to be short (one page) and used in the 48h pre-launch review + launch day cadence.

How to use:
- Owner fills the KPI snapshot and picks a gate state (GREEN/YELLOW/RED).
- If any RED → hold. If YELLOW → mitigate with canary, lower traffic % or manual QA gating.
- Keep notes and short actions in this doc; link to incident/jira if escalations are required.

Definitions / Thresholds (apply to Redwood inference SLOs):
- p95 latency threshold (sensitive routes): <= 350ms => GREEN, 350-600ms => YELLOW, >600ms => RED
- p50 latency (general): <= 120ms => GREEN, 120-250ms => YELLOW, >250ms => RED
- Error rate (5xx, model timeouts): <0.05% => GREEN, 0.05-0.2% => YELLOW, >0.2% => RED
- Delta cost per 1k tokens (hosted): <= +10% => GREEN, +10%-30% => YELLOW, >+30% => RED
- Model regression (eval set): no statistically significant degradation (p>0.05) => GREEN, small but acceptable drop (p<=0.05) => YELLOW, clear regression => RED

KPI snapshot (populate latest numbers; copy into standup):
- Feature / Change: routing: prefer-small-models-by-latency (example)
- Owner: Sofia Nguyen
- Target cohort: free-tier / canary users (10%)
- p50 latency (prod): "98ms"
- p95 latency (prod): "410ms"
- Error rate (prod 24h): "0.07%"
- Cost impact (est delta per 1k tokens): "+18%"
- Model quality delta (eval set, bleu/qa/semantic): "-0.6% (p=0.04)"
- Observability checks passing: "traces OK, no increased queueing in runtime"
- Dashboard links: "Console > Model Routing > route-pref-small (dash id 22)"

Launch readiness gate (tick one and provide notes):
- GREEN: low risk, baseline KPIs within GREEN thresholds
- YELLOW: some thresholds in YELLOW — require mitigations (canary/traffic limits/rollbacks ready)
- RED: one or more RED thresholds — do not launch

Current gate decision: "YELLOW"
Why YELLOW: p95 is above GREEN (410ms) and cost delta +18% — acceptable for canary but not for full rollout. Model quality shows minor but statistically significant drop; require targeted evals on prompt set A.

Mitigations (if YELLOW):
- Reduce canary traffic to 5% until p95 observed < 380ms for two successive 2h windows (owner: Marcus Lee)
- Temporarily enable prefix KV cache for this route (infra runbook ID: CACHE-TEMP-7) (owner: Diego Morales)
- Add additional tracing on batching histogram for 1x/2x sequence lengths (owner: Priya Patel)
- Prepare rollback PR and test the rollback in staging (PR link above)

Quick checklist (pre-launch to confirm):
- [ ] Canary config created and validated in staging (tag: canary/small-models)
- [ ] Rollback PR prepared and reviewed (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2520)
- [ ] On-call for launch day notified and runbook attached to PagerDuty incident template "launch-gate-std"
- [ ] QA smoke prompts run (sample set A/B/C) and pass rate >= 98% for intent mapping
- [ ] Billing alarm configured for cost delta > +25% (owner: finance-infra)
- [ ] Deployment window reserved in calendar and stakeholder sync (ops, infra, product)

Launch phasing recommendation (pick one):
- phased-canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (recommended for YELLOW)
- immediate-50% (only for GREEN)
- dark-launch-read/observe (if model-quality uncertain)

Escalation matrix (who to call):
- Product owner: Sofia Nguyen (pager: sylvia-nguyen@redwood.com / Slack: @sofia)
- Infra / Serving runtime lead: Diego Morales (Slack: @diego)
- Observability: Priya Patel (Slack: @priya)
- SRE on-call: rotation (see PagerDuty schedule)

Acceptance criteria before moving to next phase: list the checks that must be TRUE
- p95 <= 380ms sustained for 4h (boolean)
- Error rate change <= +0.05% absolute over baseline (boolean)
- No model regression on eval set B (sampling) (boolean)
- Cost delta trending down (after cache/batching work) (boolean)

Short runbook (1-line actions during a problem):
- If p95 > 700ms or error rate > 0.3%: immediate rollback to previous route (command: deploy route-pref-small-models --rollback) and open incident (inc: open INC-XXXX; tag: launch-rollback)
- If cost delta > +40% for 30m: reduce traffic to 1% and notify finance + product
- If model quality regression severe: pause canary, snapshot traffic samples and start evaluation run (JIRA: INF-4217)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Need a short-prompts-only eval on user prompt distribution X — Marcus to produce by 2025-11-10
- Confirm that dedicated customers pinned to model-v2 are unaffected by routing change (action: infra team to validate routing table isolation)
- Decide whether to allow auto-burst for dedicated during canary (ops risk)

Notes from last sync (2025-11-16):
- Observability team rolled a histogram patch that improved p50 variance; recompute target after patch stabilizes
- Finance requested an hourly cost preview during the 20% phase — we will enable temporary retention in Console (owner: finance-ops)

Next steps and owners (short):
- Marcus: run short-prompt eval and update model-quality matrix (due 2025-11-10)
- Diego: enable prefix cache in canary and monitor 2h windows (start 2025-11-12)
- Priya: add extra tracing and a lightweight alert rule for batching outliers (done by 2025-11-11)
- Sofia: schedule 24h launch-day war room and confirm on-call rota (due 2025-11-13)

Version history / audit trail (keep brief):
- 2025-11-02: created initial canvas (Sofia)
- 2025-11-10: updated with model-quality eval A results (Marcus)
- 2025-11-16: observability patch notes + revised p95 target (Priya)
- 2025-11-18: current snapshot and gate set to YELLOW (Sofia)

Bottom line (one-liner):
- Good candidate for a slow phased canary with caching/batching mitigations; not safe for full rollout until p95 and cost delta improve.
